checks.name: nv-mount-list-chain
checks.scope:
Production mount/storage list branches, snapshots, backend and LVGL builders.

Partition classification and presence are fixtures derived from the shipped
fstab inventory, not executed fstab parsing or real block discovery. Only mount
and storage branches of GetPartitionList are compiled; unrelated branches are
omitted. No mounting, GUI pointer dispatch, actual storage or phone is accessed.

checks.name: nv-policy-profile-runtime
checks.scope: Production activation shell, original OTA assets, fixture nodes/mounts/properties/insmod/Binder. No physical or TEE validation.

checks.name: nv-policy-module-state
checks.scope:
Run production shell against module state races, never actual insmod.

Real OTA bytes, private sysfs/property fixtures. Sleep is substituted with
deterministic state transitions to exercise the bounded wait without timing
flakiness. Unknown fixture operations fail. Does not run kernel module init.

checks.name: zip-install-chain
checks.scope:
Execute actual TWinstall_zip -> mapped package -> ZIP/verifier/digest -> updater.

Native x86_64 builds of the current AOSP ZIP and TWRP sources run in a private
chroot with ordinary files and locally generated test keys. Actual BoringSSL
host archive and AOSP host libbase/log/libc++ are hashed dependencies. Property,
DataManager/progress and unmount are doubles. ABI-named updaters contain host
code solely to check selection; no ARM64/OTA payload/GUI/sideload/device run.

checks.name: zip-selection-updater-regression
checks.scope:
Execute production ZIP updater command, fork/exec pipe parser and child wait.

The compiled host updater only emits protocol/creates a private marker. Real
fork, execve, pipe, stdio and waitpid execute; pipe/fork/fdopen failure injection
is explicit. Progress sink is checked, logs are captured. No package extraction,
ZIP signature/digest verification, payload/OTA engine, device or USB execution.
